assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Impact map 'Field Inheritance' section states: 'Priority: `Normal` — inherited from Feature TC-9002, will be propagated to all created tasks.' Summary-comment.md 'Inherited Field Propagation' table shows: 'Priority | Normal | Yes | Feature has priority set (not "Undefined"), so it is propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields: {"priority": {"name": "Normal"}}`'. The priority is explicitly documented as inherited with concrete value 'Normal'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Impact map 'Field Inheritance' section states: 'fixVersions: `RHTPA 1.6.0` — inherited from Feature TC-9002. No `fixVersion scope` setting found in Jira Field Defaults; defaulting to `"both"`, so fixVersions will be propagated to all created tasks.' Summary-comment.md confirms: 'fixVersions | RHTPA 1.6.0 | Yes | Feature has non-empty fixVersions array, and no `fixVersion scope` setting was found in Jira Field Defaults (defaults to "both"), so fixVersions are propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields: {"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]}`'. The absent scope config is correctly defaulted to 'both' and inheritance is documented.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an 'Inherited Field Propagation' table with columns Field, Feature Value, Propagated to Tasks, and Rationale. It documents Priority (Normal, propagated) and fixVersions (RHTPA 1.6.0, propagated), including the additional_fields JSON that will be used. The impact map also has a 'Field Inheritance' section with both values. Both files provide complete inherited field propagation summaries.
